utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have a fresh update yet, but I can check on it today and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive for, and when do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s for fixing up a few things around the block, mostly small repairs and cleanup. If you can help, I’d need you this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning works for me — what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to confirm the time and drop-off details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s confirm it first. Do you want me to check the time with them?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re collecting screws, duct tape, glue, and any spare tools people can lend. If you’ve got anything to spare, I can add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got some duct tape and a couple spare screwdrivers you can borrow. I’ll drop them off for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the details of the repair drive first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I haven’t got the full details on me yet. Let me check and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll take a careful look.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — I heard about the repair drive. What do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — thanks for pitching in! We could use help sorting donated tools and checking off the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m on it — I’ll sort the tools and help check off the list. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you lend a drill and a hammer for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can lend you a drill and a hammer for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive location posted yet, but I’ll keep an eye out and let you know as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’m trying to plan around the school schedule, so just let me know when you see it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I will — I’m checking for it and I’ll send it over as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on for this weekend—folks are bringing in tools, bikes, and small appliances. If you’ve got something needing a fix, it’s probably worth swinging by early.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh nice, I’ll definitely spread the word! I’ve got a bike that could use a tune-up, so I might swing by early too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect—bike tune-ups are usually a big hit. I’d get there early if you can, since the good volunteer fixers tend to get busy fast.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already set a date for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still checking with a couple neighbors before I pick one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — do you want me to help ask around, or are you waiting on a couple more replies first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others about the repair drive and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates from the others.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll do that and let everyone know what’s next for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep things organized and make sure we’ve got the repair drive covered. What’s the first item you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Let’s start with the tool list and who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll draft the tool list and match it with neighbors who can bring each item. If you already have a few names in mind, send them over and I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Eli — I heard the repair drive is set to help with a few households this week. If you want, I can pass along the details when I get them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, Tess. Please let me know the details when you have them, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and tell you as soon as I hear the schedule and what they’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—I'm still lining up the helpers and tools for the repair drive. I’ll keep folks posted as the time gets set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik—keep me posted and I’ll help if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still a bit quiet on it, but I can help if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I appreciate that—I'll write down what needs fixing and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—just bring it by when you’re ready, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m just trying to keep track of where the repair drive is happening and who’s bringing what. Can you tell me the location and the time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the location or time on me right now. If you send me the details, I’ll keep track of them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and make sure the different friend groups all hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — that would help a lot. Can you make sure they also share the date, time, and what folks should bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure the date, time, and what to bring are included when I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring a cordless drill, a tape measure, and any spare screws you have? If you’ve got work gloves too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll bring a cordless drill, a tape measure, some spare screws, and I’ll look for my work gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you hear anyone who needs a hand, send them my way and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll pass along anyone who needs help and let them know you’ve got the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes? That’d make the drive go a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes. I’ll get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to know the timing and where to drop things off so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall. Just drop everything at the side entrance, and I’ll be there to point you in the right direction.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that works for me — I’ll plan for Saturday around 10 and head to the side entrance. If anything changes, please let me know ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word fast. Tell me the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll invite the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — let’s do Saturday at 10 a.m. by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know: Saturday at 10 a.m. by the community shed. Looking forward to a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye—maybe Saturday morning around 9? That should give folks time before the school rush.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 9 works for me—I can help spread the word around the school schedule. Let me know if you want me to check with anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s make sure Nell knows the schedule and what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d really appreciate the updates. Just let me know the schedule and what to bring, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send the schedule soon, and for now just plan to bring any small tools, gloves, and whatever repair supplies you already have. I’ll keep you in the loop as everything gets set.
